reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI theme studio offering presets and per-mode customization with immediate application and local persistence through documented host and client interfaces.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供主题预设及浅色和深色模式下的颜色、字体、对比度与侧边栏透明度自定义，并支持即时应用和本地持久化。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI theme studio with presets and light- and dark-mode customization for colors, fonts, contrast, and sidebar transparency, applied instantly and stored locally.

capabilities: Customizes the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI theme
Injects theme CSS into served web pages through the documented webServer.tapIndex hook
Provides a settings interface for presets, colors, fonts, contrast, and sidebar transparency
Persists theme selections in browser localStorage
